jobs.title: ICT Officer I- Network Support Job Kabete National Polytechnic
jobs.description: Home»Jobs»Experience Level»Mid Level Jobs»ICT Officer I- Network Support Job Kabete National Polytechnic
responsibilities: Resolving network-related user support requests, diagnosing connectivity problems, troubleshooting incidents and escalating complex network issues to the appropriate technical personnel;
Installing, configuring, administering and maintaining network infrastructure, including routers, switches, wireless access points, network printers and other network devices;
Monitoring network performance, availability and connectivity, identifying faults and implementing corrective measures to ensure reliable access to Polytechnical ICT services;
Configuring and maintaining local area networks (LANs), wireless local area networks (WLANs), structured cabling, network ports and related connectivity infrastructure;
Implementing approved network security measures, including access controls, VLAN segmentation, firewall rules and secure wireless configurations, in accordance with Polytechnical ICT policies;
Administering network services and protocols, including TCP/IP, IP addressing, subnetting, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), Domain Name System (DNS) and network authentication services;
requirements: Have a Bachelor’s degree in any of the following disciplines: Computer Science, Information Technology, Information and Communication Technology, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Business Information Technology, or any other equivalent ICT- related qualification

Have a professional certification in computer networking: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), CompTIA Network+, Huawei HCIA-Datacom, MikroTik Certified Network Associate (MTCNA) or an equivalent certification;

Demonstrate practical skills in installing, configuring and troubleshooting routers, switches, wireless access points and structured cabling, gained through industrial attachment, internship or practical work;
Have working knowledge of TCP/IP, IP addressing and subnetting, VLANs, DHCP, DNS and network security, and of Windows Server or Linux server administration; and
Knowledge of network monitoring tools, IP telephony (VoIP) and IP-based CCTV; and
jobs.howToApply: Interested candidates who meet the above criteria should submit a cover letter, a detailed CV, and attach copies of National Identity Card, relevant professional and academic certificates and transcripts.
